# QR generator

[qrcode.js](./qrcode.js) is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.mjs` from
[`qrcode-generator` 2.0.4](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator),
renamed to `.js` for this site's static server. Downloaded from the npm release
(`qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz`, SHA-1 `e8b3f30922577eba52078aa9c0d5a2a74fe1fd94`).

Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase. Distributed under the [MIT license](./LICENSE).
It is shipped with the site so progress and QR generation never need an external
service. Excluded from repository formatting/linting to preserve upstream code.
